name: Card
description: A structural surface for related content without ambiguous interactive behavior.
usage:
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Security report</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Updated five minutes ago</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>No critical findings were detected.</CardContent>
</Card>

anatomy.description: The heading block holding CardTitle and CardDescription.
The main body region of the card.
The trailing region for metadata or secondary actions.

dos: Compose with the header, content, and footer parts so spacing rhythm stays consistent.
Set the polymorphic as prop (article, section, li) to fit the page outline.
Keep one clear topic per card.
donts: Don't make the whole card clickable when it also contains links or buttons.
Don't wrap every section in a card just for decoration.
Don't bury the page's primary action inside a card footer.

examples.title: Composition
examples.description: Cards compose header, content, and footer regions with consistent rhythm.

examples.title: Report summary
examples.description: Use a card to group a short summary and one related action.

guidance.useWhen: Related content needs a structural surface.
guidance.avoidWhen: A card is being used only to decorate every section or hide a primary action.
guidance.behavior: Card is non-interactive by default and accepts an explicit polymorphic element.
guidance.responsive: Use compact padding and let card content define its width.

notes: Cards are passive surfaces with no keyboard behavior of their own.
Render real links and buttons inside a card rather than making the card itself clickable.
The as prop lets you render the card as a section, article, or list item to fit the page outline.
Disabled cards are dimmed, skip pointer events, and set aria-disabled.
CardTitle renders an h2 by default; set titleAs so card headings fit the surrounding page outline.

props.description: Applies disabled styling and blocks interaction on interactive cards.
props.name: disabled

props.description: Button type used when the card renders an interactive element.
props.name: type

props.description: Heading element used for the title; defaults to 'h2'. Adjust to fit the page outline.
props.name: titleAs
